entries.name: Image Analyzer
entries.description: Analyzes uploaded images to detect objects, scenes and emotions and generate detailed natural-language descriptions for accessibility and content workflows. Billed per call via x402 on Base.

usage.outputShape: body.description (natural-language description string), body.objects[] ({name, position:{x,y,width,height}} normalized 0-1 bbox), body.insights.mood, body.insights.context, body.processedAt
quirks: inputSchema is null in the registry; the correct body field is image_url (a publicly-accessible image URL). Field name was inferred, not documented.
Synchronous: full analysis returns in the paid 200 response, no polling.
qa-pay reported confirmed:false / txHash:null but status 200 with valid body — settlement succeeded, the txHash just was not surfaced.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/image_analyzer with a JSON body {"image_url": "<public image URL>"} and pay the x402 charge ($0.01 USDC on Base). The response is synchronous JSON: read body.description for the natural-language caption, body.objects[] for detected objects with normalized bounding boxes, and body.insights.mood / body.insights.context for scene/emotion analysis. The image URL must be publicly fetchable. No API key or sign-in required beyond the x402 payment.

entries.name: Medical Image Analyzer
entries.description: Analyzes medical images such as X-rays and MRIs to detect anomalies and return preliminary diagnostic insights. Billed per call via x402 on Base.

quirks: inputSchema was null in registry; the body requires BOTH image_url and image_type — omitting image_type returns a 400 'Validation failed' (and you are still charged $0.01).
image_type is a free-text string; 'xray' was accepted. Use a modality string like 'xray' or 'mri'.
Pays $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call even on validation failures — always include image_type to avoid a wasted charge.
Synchronous: full diagnostic result returns inline in the 200 body, no polling.
Output includes a disclaimer that this is AI preliminary screening, not a formal diagnosis.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body to https://gg402.vercel.app/medical_image_analyzer with both image_url (a publicly fetchable image URL) and image_type (a modality string such as 'xray' or 'mri'). Payment is $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. CRITICAL: image_type is required even though it is not in any published schema — omitting it returns a 400 but still charges you. Read the result from the 200 JSON body: body.anomalies_detected is an array of {anomaly, confidence, location} and body.diagnostic_insights is a prose radiology-style summary. It is synchronous; no polling needed.

entries.name: Describe Image (Vision LLM)
entries.description: Vision-LLM image analysis with selectable modes: full description, accessibility alt-text, OCR text extraction, keyword tags, or single-sentence caption. Billed per call via x402 on Base.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/describe-image with JSON body {image_url, mode} (x402 USDC on Base, $0.02/call)
usage.outputShape: On success: body holds the vision-LLM analysis text (description/alt-text/OCR/tags/caption per mode). On failure: body.error (string). Errors deep-reference messages[0].content[1].image_url.url, confirming an OpenAI-style vision payload internally.
quirks: Body is {image_url, mode}; mode selects the analysis type (full description, accessibility alt-text, OCR text extraction, keyword tags, single-sentence caption).
image_url MUST be a direct, static, publicly-reachable image (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, or image/gif). The worker downloads it server-side.

Redirect-based or generated image URLs (e.g. picsum.photos/*.jpg) get rejected with 'Supplied image did not pass validation checks'; Wikipedia thumbnail URLs returned 'Failed to download one or more images'. Use a plain hosted .jpg/.png.

On image-download/validation failure the endpoint returns HTTP 502 with body.error 'Both models failed...' AFTER charging $0.02 — payment is NOT refunded, so validate your image URL is fetchable first.
Endpoint reaches the upstream model pipeline correctly; failures are image-source issues, not a dead route.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/describe-image with JSON {"image_url":"<direct static image URL>","mode":"caption"}. Pay $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base; no API key. mode selects: description, alt-text, OCR, tags, or caption. Provide a directly-fetchable image (jpeg/png/webp/gif); redirecting/generated URLs are rejected upstream. Read analysis text from the JSON body; a 502 with body.error 'Both models failed' means the image was unreachable/invalid and you were still charged.

entries.name: Logo Detection
entries.description: Detects brand logos and visual brand elements in an image, returning confidence scores and element types (wordmark, logomark, lockup, color scheme, context). Billed per call via x402 on Base.

usage.outputShape: body.detected_brands[] (each {name, confidence, where_in_image, evidence, element_type}); body.overall_summary; body.no_brands_detected (bool); body.model
quirks: inputSchema is null in the registry; the correct request field is image_url (a publicly-fetchable raster image URL such as PNG/JPG).
The image must be reachable by the worker. Some hosts (e.g. Wikimedia upload thumbs) gate non-browser user agents; use a plainly-accessible raster image URL.
Result is plain synchronous JSON, status 200, billed $0.03 via x402 on Base (eip155:8453, USDC).
Detection findings are in detected_brands[]; check no_brands_detected to know if nothing was found.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/logo-detect with a JSON body {"image_url":"<public raster image URL>"} and pay the $0.03 x402 charge (USDC on Base). The response is synchronous JSON. Read detected brands from body.detected_brands[] — each entry has name, confidence, where_in_image, evidence, and element_type (wordmark/logomark/etc.). Use body.no_brands_detected and body.overall_summary for a quick read. Make sure the image_url is fetchable by the server (a plain PNG/JPG URL; avoid UA-gated hosts and SVGs).

entries.name: Channel3 Visual Product Search
entries.description: Visual product search — submit an image URL or base64 image and find visually matching products in the Channel3 catalog. Billed per call via x402 on Base.

usage.callShape: POST https://stableproduct.dev/api/channel3/image-search with JSON body {image_url} (or {base64_image}), optional {limit:1-30, filters, config, include_raw, page_token}
usage.outputShape: body.products[] each with .id, .title, .brands[].name, .main_image_url, .categories[], .price.price/.currency, .availability, .best_offer.url, .offers[]; body.next_page_token for pagination
usage.guide: Send a POST with a JSON body containing either image_url (a publicly reachable image URL) or base64_image. Optionally set limit (1-30), filters (brand/gender/condition/price/availability/etc.), and config (language/country/currency). It costs $0.01 USDC on Base per call and returns synchronously. Read matches from body.products[]: use .title, .brands[].name, .price.price, and .best_offer.url (the buy link). Pass body.next_page_token back as page_token to fetch more results.

entries.name: Diffbot Image Analysis
entries.description: Extract structured metadata from an image URL — caption, dimensions, dominant colors and detected objects — using Diffbot. Billed per call via MPP.

entries.name: Analyze Image
entries.description: Extracts raw OCR text and detected objects from images using GPT-4o Vision, returning clean machine-readable data without interpretation.

usage.callShape: POST https://cnvrt.ing/api/analyze-image with JSON body {url} or {file} (+optional detail), x402 USDC on Base. NOTE: registry's GET method is WRONG — GET returns 404 'Cannot GET'.
quirks: REGISTRY METHOD IS WRONG: it lists GET, but GET (and PUT) return HTTP 404 'Cannot GET /api/analyze-image'. The endpoint ONLY accepts POST. Must be corrected to POST.
POST returns a valid x402 402 challenge: 0.005 USDC (5000 units) on Base, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0xfad67Ce5A834E68d5533bA7Ac08619fF82a42084, scheme exact.
Body requires either url (public image URL) OR file (base64 data URI data:image/...;base64,...). Both optional in schema but you need one of them. Optional detail: 'low'|'high'|'auto' (default high).
Registry priceDisplay 'Varies' is misleading — observed flat 0.005 USDC from the live 402.

Could NOT complete a paid round-trip from this QA environment: the money-safe qa-pay tool (node) consistently fails DNS resolution for cnvrt.ing ('fetch failed', $0 spent). The endpoint resolves fine via 8.8.8.8 (Cloudflare-fronted, Railway backend, x-service-health: healthy) and was reached by forcing the IP. The paid response body is therefore unverified — only the 402 challenge/schema is confirmed.
usage.guide: Call POST https://cnvrt.ing/api/analyze-image (NOT GET — GET 404s) with a JSON body containing either {"url":"<public image url>"} or {"file":"data:image/png;base64,..."}, plus optional "detail":"low"|"high"|"auto". It is x402-paywalled at 0.005 USDC on Base (pay via your x402 wallet; no API key/SIWX). On success read body.ocr_text for extracted text, body.detected_objects[] for the object list, and body.metadata for model/detail info. Synchronous — the result returns in the same response.

entries.name: TCG Card Grade Oracle
entries.description: Uses AI vision to analyze images of physical Trading Card Game (TCG) cards and predict their PSA and Beckett grades.

usage.outputShape: N/A — endpoint returns HTTP 500 {detail} instead of a grade. Useful result is never produced via REST.
quirks: REST route /api/v1/grade is a non-functional stub: it accepts the image_url query param (422 confirms it is required) but then returns HTTP 500 with {"detail":"Tool 'grade_card' requires the full MCP server. Use the MCP protocol directly."}
No x402 402 challenge is ever issued on this REST route — it 422s (missing param) or 500s (stub) before any payment step, so it cannot be paid for via HTTP/x402.
Grading is only available over the MCP protocol (tool name 'grade_card'), not this HTTP endpoint.
usage.guide: Do not use the REST endpoint GET https://oracle.the-undesirables.com/api/v1/grade — it is broken. It requires an image_url query param, but even with a valid public TCG card image URL it returns HTTP 500 stating the grade_card tool requires the full MCP server and to use the MCP protocol directly. No payment is ever charged. If grading is needed, connect to the service over MCP and call the grade_card tool instead of this HTTP route.
